reason: The grip handle on each line-item row is a span with role button and no name; only the drag instructions reach the tree as its description, so 4.1.2 fails on both states. The handle only reorders line items, which the payment does not need, and aria-roledescription sortable plus the instructions still hint at its use, so this is friction: low.
